features.title: Softer sticky-header shadow
features.how: Watch the header as the page scrolls down.
features.difference: Before: the existing header shadow. After: a softer shadow transition.

features.title: Short product-menu entrance
features.how: Watch the product menu opening, especially its top edge.
features.difference: Before: appears immediately. After: fades in while moving down 5px. The fully open menus look the same.

features.title: Product-menu row feedback
features.how: Watch the first product-menu row as its background changes.
features.difference: Before: immediate hover colour. After: colour eases in.

features.title: Eased dropdown chevron
features.how: Watch the small arrow beside Our products.
features.difference: Before: existing arrow turn. After: a gentler easing and timing.

features.title: Mobile menu entrance
features.how: On mobile, watch the menu panel open.
features.difference: Before: existing opening. After: a short fade and settle. Desktop navigation is unaffected.

features.title: Consistent keyboard focus
features.how: Watch the outline around the focused link or control.
features.difference: Before: existing browser/site focus. After: a consistent dark red outline.

features.title: Button colour transitions
features.how: Watch the main button colour change.
features.difference: Before: existing hover response. After: a short colour transition.

features.title: Subtle button press
features.how: Watch the button while it is pressed.
features.difference: Before: existing pressed state. After: contracts to 98.5%, then releases.

features.title: Directional arrow movement
features.how: Watch the arrow beside Learn more.
features.difference: Before: stays in place. After: travels 3px toward the destination.

features.title: Text-link underline feedback
features.how: Watch an article link underline.
features.difference: Before: existing underline. After: a thicker underline and eased colour on hover.

features.title: Small product-photo zoom
features.how: Watch the product photograph.
features.difference: Before: existing photo. After: a small zoom when its Learn more link is hovered.

features.title: Product heading responds to links
features.how: Watch the product name while its link is hovered.
features.difference: Before: existing heading colour. After: changes to dark red.

features.title: Small blog-photo zoom
features.how: Watch the first blog photograph.
features.difference: Before: existing photo response. After: a subtle zoom on link hover.

features.title: Article-card border feedback
features.how: Watch the rule beneath the blog card.
features.difference: Before: beige divider. After: divider changes to dark red on link hover.

features.title: Clear field-focus transition
features.how: Watch the border around a text field when focused.
features.difference: Before: existing focus. After: a dark red border with a faint surrounding edge.

features.title: Quiet filled-field state
features.how: Watch a field after text is entered and focus moves away.
features.difference: Before: existing field background. After: a very slight warm tint. This is deliberately subtle.

features.title: Edited valid-field feedback
features.how: Watch the border after a valid field is edited and blurred.
features.difference: Before: existing border. After: a muted warm border. No validation rules change.

features.title: Validation-message appearance
features.how: Watch the field error message appear.
features.difference: Before: text appears immediately. After: a short fade. Replay uses a sample message and does not submit the form.

features.title: Checkbox and radio feedback
features.how: Watch the checkbox or radio as you hover it.
features.difference: Before: existing control. After: the dark red accent subtly darkens.

features.title: Message box grows with your writing
features.how: Watch the message box while several lines are entered.
features.difference: Before: its existing height. After: grows to fit your message, up to a limit.

features.title: Slider progress track
features.how: Watch the slider track as its value changes.
features.difference: Before: existing track. After: red filled portion follows the slider.

features.title: Slider hover and keyboard feedback
features.how: Watch the slider thumb when focused.
features.difference: Before: existing thumb. After: a soft focus ring and a slight size increase.

features.title: Result update feedback
features.how: Watch the calculator result after a slider changes.
features.difference: Before: immediate number update. After: the new result briefly takes the dark red accent. The calculation is the same.

features.title: Calculator tab crossfade
features.how: Watch the calculator panel as the product tab changes.
features.difference: Before: panel switches directly. After: the new panel briefly fades to full opacity.

features.title: Smooth FAQ opening and closing
features.how: Watch the FAQ answer open and close.
features.difference: Before: instant height change. After: height opens and closes smoothly. The final open answer is identical.

features.title: Thin reading-progress indicator
features.how: Watch just below the header as you scroll the policy.
features.difference: Before: no reading indicator. After: a thin red line tracks your position.

features.title: Current contents-section marker
features.how: Watch the contents links as you scroll between headings.
features.difference: Before: unchanged contents links. After: the current section is underlined in dark red.

features.title: Back-to-top control
features.how: Scroll down and watch the lower-right corner.
features.difference: Before: no new button. After: a small Back to top control appears.

features.title: Search-result appearance
features.how: Watch bank cards after searching for HSBC.
features.difference: Before: results appear directly. After: returned cards settle in with a short fade.

features.title: Smoother anchors with header clearance
features.how: Watch the move to the funding steps section.
features.difference: Before: existing anchor behaviour. After: a smooth scroll with space below the fixed header.
